newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt overnight, one-week rates up in short market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt overnight, one-week rates up in short market.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound rose in a tight private market on Sunday to between 10 1/8 and 10 3/8 percent, from Thursday's range of 10 1/8 and 10 3/16 percent, bankers said.
Bankers said it was normal for rates to edge higher at the start of the week. "Everyone is looking for Egyptian pounds to cover his reserve requirements for the week," said one.
Another banker said the liquidity was being absorbed by central bank treasury bills, causing a short market.
One week rates were up slightly to 10 1/4 and 10 3/8, the bankers added. Public sector banks continued to ask for a minimum 10 1/2 percent.
